proposition: In the R. Anjām Ibn Turka describes Akhlāṭī's writings as 'moon-splitting' (arqām-i aqmār inshiqāq-i sayyidī), by which locks on the veils over the Quran were opened.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, paraphrasing or translating Ibn Turka's own work
mediation.note: quoted in a footnote in Melvin-Koushki's translation
